options.content:
**Dashboard 2 of 4 (Section 12.4).** Policy activity and HITL activity across every policy pack, not just AML (Dashboard 3 is AML-specific).

Backed by `agg_policy_fires_daily`/`agg_hitl_daily` (`interpose.analytics.aggregate_telemetry`), synthetic data, fixed 2026-07-06 to 2026-08-03 window -- same reasoning as Dashboard 1.

**Named gap:** Agent A2 (anomaly detector) and Agent A4 (incident escalator) output (`interpose.control_plane`) isn't persisted anywhere queryable for historical aggregation -- it's computed live per-event and never written back to the audit log or a durable table. This dashboard can't show it until that's built; not faked here. See concepts/32-synthetic-telemetry-and-postgres-backed-dashboards.md .

panels.title: Policy fires per day, by policy and outcome

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day AS time,
               policy_name || ' (' || outcome || ')' AS metric,
               sum(fire_count) AS value
        FROM agg_policy_fires_daily
        WHERE source = 'synthetic' AND $__timeFilter(day)
        GROUP BY day, policy_name, outcome
        ORDER BY day

panels.title: HITL tickets created per day, by reviewer group

targets.rawSql:
SELECT day AS time, reviewer_group AS metric, tickets_created AS value
        FROM agg_hitl_daily
        WHERE source = 'synthetic' AND $__timeFilter(day)
        ORDER BY day

panels.title: HITL median response time, by reviewer group

targets.rawSql:
SELECT reviewer_group AS metric, avg(median_response_seconds) AS value
        FROM agg_hitl_daily
        WHERE source = 'synthetic' AND $__timeFilter(day)
        GROUP BY reviewer_group

SELECT 'Approved' AS metric, sum(approved) AS value
        FROM agg_hitl_daily WHERE source = 'synthetic' AND $__timeFilter(day)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'Denied', sum(denied)
        FROM agg_hitl_daily WHERE source = 'synthetic' AND $__timeFilter(day)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'Timed out', sum(timed_out)
        FROM agg_hitl_daily WHERE source = 'synthetic' AND $__timeFilter(day)

options.content: **Named gap, not populated.** Agent A2's anomaly flags and Agent A4's incident promotions (`interpose.control_plane.agents.anomaly_detector`/`incident_escalator`) are computed live, per `DecisionEvent`, and never written to a durable, queryable table -- there's no historical record for an aggregation job to summarize. Persisting control-plane decisions (not just the gateway's own policy decisions) is future work, named here rather than faked with synthetic numbers this project can't back up.
